description: This file defines an interface named EvictingQueue that extends the java.util.Queue interface, providing additional methods for adding elements with automatic eviction when a size limit is reached. It is related to a specific package dealing with messaging and monitoring logs within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue with eviction if necessary; replaces java.util.Queue's add method.

methods.name: offer
methods.description: Offers an element to the queue with eviction if necessary; replaces java.util.Queue's offer method.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all elements from a collection to the queue with eviction as needed; overrides java.util.Queue's addAll method.
